system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Geomorpho90m Second order derivatives: Profile Curvature (pcurv)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global Geomorpho90m profile curvature dataset in WGS84, organized as spatial tiles rather than a single monolithic raster.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Static geomorphometric profile curvature tile collection derived from MERIT DEM; each image represents a spatial terrain tile rather than a time step.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; spatial tiles only
data_description.records: 1148 spatial profile curvature tiles in collection

band_semantics.b1: Profile curvature raster for the spatial tile encoded by `system:index`. Profile curvature is measured in the vertical plane aligned with the direction of maximum slope.

data_description.important_note: The asset suffix `pcurv` denotes profile curvature; the collection is organized as spatial tiles, not as a dated time series. Confirm the product's sign convention before assigning positive or negative values to acceleration, deceleration, erosion, or deposition behavior.
analytical_capabilities: Downslope flow acceleration and deceleration assessment

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Profile curvature in the vertical plane parallel to the direction of maximum slope.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Treat `system:index` values as tile identifiers and `pixel_resolution` as the spatial-resolution cue. Verify the source sign convention before interpreting curvature direction.

data_description.data_source: Yale University, Coillte, Irish State Forestry Board, Leibniz-Institute of Freshwater Ecology and Inland Fisheries, European Commission - Joint Research Centre, Spatial Ecology via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
